_comment: Folio legal docs manifest. Source of truth for the latest ToS / Privacy version: a GitHub Action syncs this into Supabase tos_versions (which the app reads), and it is also bundled into the app as an offline fallback. Bump version + summary when ToS / Privacy changes.

terms.summary_zh: v1.6：§06 用戶內容列舉補上虛擬書房（房名、佈置、便條疊）、訪客簿留言與漂流瓶信件；帳號刪除後留存節補述訪客簿留言匿名保留與筆友通信唯讀紀念。既有機制之揭露補充、無新增權利義務 → minor、既有用戶靜默。
terms.summary_en: v1.6: §06 UGC enumeration now covers study rooms (name, arrangement, paper-note stack), guestbook comments, and drift-bottle letters; the post-deletion retention section adds anonymised guestbook comments and read-only pen-pal correspondence. Disclosure catch-up for existing mechanisms; no new rights or obligations → minor, silent for existing users.

privacy.summary_zh: v1.7：補齊虛擬書房與漂流瓶之揭露：§02 蒐集（房名 / 佈置 / 便條疊 / 可見性、讚與訪客簿留言、漂流瓶信件與收藏副本）、§04 用戶間顯示（今日書房展、不公開＝知悉連結且登入者可檢視、留言具名、讚之通知含暱稱、漂流瓶匿名投遞）、§06 保留與刪帳號（訪客簿留言匿名化、筆友線唯讀紀念、信匣副本與封存區）。皆屬既有功能於既已同意目的下之透明度補充、無新第三方、無新目的 → minor、既有用戶靜默、不需重新同意。
privacy.summary_en: v1.7: adds disclosure for study rooms and drift bottles: §02 collection (room name / arrangement / paper-note stack / visibility, likes and guestbook comments, drift-bottle letters and saved copies), §04 inter-user visibility (daily room exhibition, unlisted rooms viewable by signed-in link holders, comments shown with nickname, like notifications carry nickname, anonymous bottle delivery), §06 retention and deletion (anonymised guestbook comments, read-only pen-pal mementos, saved-letter copies and archive). Transparency catch-up for existing features under already-consented purposes; no new third party, no new purpose → minor, silent for existing users, no re-consent.
